items.title: 60322_John Bubbles oral history interview
items.q: Buck and I was Rum and Dink and the managers of Erskine Miller... they could use a comedy team for two comedians in the show called Rum and Dink.

ctx.x: '32, I think it was, '32 or '33. However -- so we wanted to get -- the show got a good write-up, there was good costumes and good story but they had no names in the show, the character show. So that means Billy Rose wanted to get a name act to put in. So he had a spot -- they could use a comedy team for two comedians in the show called Rum and Dink. Rum and Dink was the name of the comedians that he had in the show and he'd figured he'd get Buck and Bubbles and name them Rum and Dink and they'd have a name act.
